text:
Real-data migration and isolated Rust policy/GP training

Usage: jope-parallel [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  doctor                             
  compare-seeds                      
  build-corpus                       
  export-teaching-corpus             
  project-corpus                     Write a self-contained corpus copy restricted to training and validation contexts
  comparison-baseline                
  enqueue                            
  expand-cuts                        
  index-cuts                         
  registry-initialize-native         Initialize new held native-fit storage; existing authorities are never overwritten
  registry-witness-initialize        Initialize an empty independent witness store from reviewed public policy
  registry-inspect-runtime           Observe this loaded CPU executable and numerical runtime without authorizing work
  registry-authority                 Own all physical regression fits through one durable native authority
  funding-request                    Transport a typed funding request through the protected native client
  query-evaluate                     Score a retained committed model with separately authorized query access
  query-retrieve                     Retrieve an original query result without extending its execution deadline
  registry-witness-inspect           Verify the original public witness ledger without accessing either signing key
  registry-witness-request           Retain one authenticated independent witness request from standard input
  registry-witness-add-native-grant  Append one independently provisioned exact native grant to the original witness ledger
  registry-witness-epoch-transition  Append an independently reviewed epoch transition to the original witness ledger
  registry-witness-get-ack           Retrieve an original witness acknowledgment without recording another event
  history-stage                      Capture a reviewed inventory without publishing coverage or enabling fits
  history-import-batch               
  history-prepare-lookup-index       Explicitly prepare the derived global historical lookup index; no admission
  history-commit-coverage            
  native-scope-inspect               Inspect signed preparation identities and the original authority head without issuing authorization
  native-scope-register              
  history-commit-aggregate-coverage  Commit complete original namespace coverage from independently reviewed aggregate evidence
  recovery-inspect                   
  recovery-replay                    
  recovery-reconcile                 
  recovery-commit-epoch              
  namespace-activate                 
  namespace-deactivate               
  hyperion-service                   
  fit                                
  fit-view                           
  predict                            
  score                              
  outer-release                      Outer (sealed final-test) score release authority: init, grant, score, release and events. Sealed labels reach only a granted outer scorer; the score is withheld until released, once
  bootstrap                          
  search                             
  gp-service                         
  snapshot                           
  freeze-families                    
  audit                              
  prepare                            
  stage                              
  transfer                           
  verify                             
  status                             
  tui                                
  learning-history                   Read the full saved loss history without starting training or writing files
  monitor                            
  pilot-gate                         Check prerequisites; cannot launch an unqualified pilot
  help                               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  [default: .]
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version
